verdicts.reason: Both lose the hero coffee bag: it shrinks to a thumbnail and leaves a huge empty blurred photo panel on the left. Both also put the CTA above the headline, which breaks the reading order. A's bag and logo are small but still recognisable, though they are pushed into the bottom corner next to a SAVE badge that floats loose, and the right-aligned CTA does not line up with the left text edge. B is worse: its bag and Q logo shrink to roughly 20px specks that cannot be read, so the brand is gone, and its centred CTA and centred badge sit on a different axis from the left-aligned headline.
